item.title: OpenAI's Footnote Problem: Why the Imminent AI Preemption Executive Order May Face Immediate Legal Headwinds

item.title: Eliminating the GRAS Pathway: An Update
item.description: Legislation introduced in the U.S. Senate in November, informally called the “Better FDA Act of 2025,” is perhaps a bit misleading. item.title: Illinois Amends the Workplace Transparency Act Effective January 1, 2026—Tips for Employers
item.description: Illinois has enacted significant amendments to the Workplace Transparency Act (WTA), effective January 1, 2026, that will materially affect employment, separation, and settlement agreements with Illinois employees, applicants, contractors, and consultants. item.title: Connecticut Order Lists Approved Phrases for July 1, 2026, Labeling Requirement
item.description: Beginning July 1, 2026, Connecticut will require that certain consumer products containing intentionally added per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS) be labeled. The products subject to the labeling requirement include apparel; carpets or rugs; cleaning products; cookware; cosmetic products; dental floss; fabric treatments; juvenile products; menstruation products; textile furnishings; ski wax; or upholstered furniture.
